findings.title: _parse_report_row() builds naive datetimes that are compared with aware ones
findings.body_markdown: Adyen's report timestamps carry no offset and `_parse_report_row()` parses them with `datetime.strptime` (line 34); `match_payouts()` compares them with the aware `payout.booked_at`, which raises `TypeError` on the first row.

severity.explanation: untested × proven × reachable internally × blast radius 0.30 × churn 0.30

proof.test_code:
"""Repro for a prguard finding in app/reconcile/adyen.py::_parse_report_row.

Claim: report rows parse to naive datetimes.
"""

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from app.reconcile.adyen import parse_booked_at


def test_report_timestamps_compare_with_booked_payouts():
    assert parse_booked_at("2026-08-18 23:14:09") < datetime(2026, 8, 19, tzinfo=UTC)

findings.title: Compare settlement amounts in integer cents in _within_tolerance()
findings.body_markdown: `_within_tolerance()` compares `abs(expected - actual) < 0.01` on floats (line 67); integer cents avoid a tolerance that is itself a binary fraction.

severity.explanation: reachable internally × unproven × blast radius 0.10 × churn 0.15

suppression.reason: Reconciliation compares amounts that were rounded to the cent when the report was loaded; the float tolerance is deliberate. Tracked in LEDGER-412.

findings.title: Annotate the return type of `match_payouts()`
findings.body_markdown: `match_payouts()` is the only function in `app/reconcile/adyen.py` without a return annotation.

findings.title: Replace the sleep in the test for `reconcile_settlements()` with a fake clock
findings.body_markdown: The test for `reconcile_settlements()` sleeps for two seconds to cross a boundary.
